title: Nvidia’s booming demand is ‘hard to ignore,’ but these four questions loom over the stock
snippet: Nvidia investors face uncertainty around CEO succession, the AI ecosystem, export controls and China.
mechanism: AI-driven chip demand and export-control-induced supply concentration are sustaining an elevated semiconductor equipment investment cycle, with TSMC capacity expansion and domestic-fab subsidies creating multi-year earnings visibility for the equipment-and-materials stack.

title: How copper’s plunge could hurt the AI buildout
snippet: The world might not be able to mine enough copper to meet AI’s demand for years to come.
mechanism: Frontier-model labs and hyperscalers are committing to multi-gigawatt training clusters faster than accelerator supply can scale, turning raw compute access into the binding competitive constraint and a durable demand floor under the entire AI hardware stack.

title: Direct lenders provide $1.3bn for L Catterton’s Fullscript deal
snippet: A group of private credit managers has provided a $1.3bn loan to finance L Catterton and Altas Partners’ acquisition of a majority stake in healthcare platform Fullscript, replacing debt commitments underwritten by a Morgan Stanley-led bank group, according to a report by Bloomberg.Morgan Stanley reportedly placed the loan with direct lenders including Antares Capital, Blue Owl Capital, Carlyle and Golub Capital.
